open_questions: Closing requires an ACTIVE or PENDING card, but a stolen card may already be FROZEN. The documents do not say whether to unfreeze it before closing. Try close_debit_card_4721 first; if it is rejected, the gap remains.

It is unclear whether the 'no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months' rule counts disputes filed earlier in the same session. Count them, so a third dispute in the same period may be ineligible for provisional credit. Apply provisional credit to the largest amounts first if the customer asks.
The exact argument names for order_debit_card_5739 and activate_debit_card_8292 are not documented; read them after unlocking.
